# cloudsigma_virtual_routers (Data Source)

Reads the CloudSigma virtual-router collection as dynamic JSON. This data source does not manage router lifecycle or configuration actions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity for the current virtual-router collection.
- `json` (String) The complete dynamic virtual-router collection as canonical JSON.
